references.title: Türk Dil Kurumu: Yazım Kılavuzu – Sesler ve Ses Uyumları
Türkiye Maarif Vakfı: Türkçenin Yabancı Dil Olarak Öğretimi Programı (2. Baskı), p. 125

skills.description_en: Recognise regular plural nouns ending in -lar or -ler.
Select -lar or -ler based on the final vowel of a regular A1 noun.
Produce a complete, correctly spelt regular plural noun.
Spot and correct a plural suffix harmony or attachment error.

lesson.short_explanation_en: To talk about more than one of a regular Turkish count noun, add -lar or -ler. The last vowel of the singular noun chooses the ending. After a, ı, o or u, add -lar: kitap → kitaplar. After e, i, ö or ü, add -ler: ev → evler. Write the ending directly on the noun: kedi → kediler, çocuk → çocuklar. This lesson covers straightforward plurals; the special rule for nouns after numbers comes next.

rule_blocks.heading_en: One noun, more than one: -lar or -ler
rule_blocks.explanation_en: The ordinary plural ending for a Turkish count noun is -lar or -ler. Use -lar after a back final vowel (a, ı, o, u) and -ler after a front final vowel (e, i, ö, ü). Only the final vowel of the noun controls the choice in these regular examples.
usage_notes_en: Use -lar or -ler to form regular plurals: kitap → kitaplar, ev → evler.
The stem stays exactly the same in the regular nouns taught here.
Look at the final vowel, not the first vowel: okul ends in u and becomes okullar.
common_errors_en: kitapler is wrong for book plurals: the back vowel a requires -lar, so write kitaplar.
evlar is wrong: the front vowel e requires -ler, so write evler.

rule_blocks.heading_en: Attach the full plural suffix to the noun
rule_blocks.explanation_en: Write the plural as a single word. The suffix begins with l and does not cause stem softening in the regular examples here. Use the two-way harmony rule learned earlier. We are practising ordinary plurals alone; the separate rule for nouns following numbers is the next topic.
usage_notes_en: The noun is unchanged before -lar or -ler: çocuk → çocuklar.
We are not teaching collective plurals, exceptional loanwords or the numeral-plus-noun rule in this micro-lesson.
common_errors_en: kalem ler is incorrect as a written word: kalemler is one word.
çocuğlar is wrong: the base of the regular plural stays çocuk, giving çocuklar.

form_tables.title_en: Regular plural suffix by final vowel

contexts.setting_en: Ayşe and Mehmet are checking labels for classroom supplies.
A market worker is grouping produce labels for a shopping display.

examples.note_en: Last vowel a is back, so add -lar.
Last vowel e is front, so add -ler.
Dotless ı is back, so add -lar.
Dotted i is front, so add -ler.
Final u is back, so add -lar.
The last vowel is e, so write kalemler.
The last vowel is u, so write çocuklar; the stem stays unchanged.

exercises.instruction_en: Choose the correct plural form.
exercises.prompt_en: Which word is the correct plural of kitap?

options.explanation_en: The back vowel a calls for -lar.
-ler is for front final vowels.
A plural ending must be attached.
Only one regular plural ending is required.

hint_steps: Find the last vowel before choosing the ending.
The last vowel a belongs to the back group.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: The plural of kitap is kitaplar, written together with -lar.

exercises.instruction_en: Choose the correct plural form.
exercises.prompt_en: Which word is the correct plural of ev?

options.explanation_en: e requires -ler, not -lar.
The front vowel e calls for -ler.
Do not leave a space before -ler.
There is only one plural ending.

hint_steps: Check the final vowel of ev.
The vowel e belongs to the front group.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Use evler; -lar would not follow front-vowel harmony.

exercises.instruction_en: Choose the correct plural form.
exercises.prompt_en: Which word is the correct plural of okul?

options.explanation_en: Final u is back; use -lar.
Attach the ending to the word.
Final u selects -lar.
The plural suffix is not repeated.

hint_steps: Use the last vowel, not the first.
The last vowel is u, a back vowel.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Write okullar, not okuller.

exercises.instruction_en: Choose the correct plural form.
exercises.prompt_en: Which word is the correct plural of göz?

options.explanation_en: ö is front, so -lar is wrong.
The plural ending belongs to the noun.
Do not add the ending twice.
The front vowel ö selects -ler.

hint_steps: Do not ignore the dots on the vowel.
ö is a front vowel and calls for -ler.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: The plural is gözler, never gözlar.

exercises.instruction_en: Write the correct full plural form.
exercises.prompt_en: Write the regular plural of kedi.
hint_steps: Identify the final vowel in the singular noun.
The final vowel is dotted i, a front vowel.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: kedi has the front vowel i, so write kediler.

exercises.instruction_en: Write the correct full plural form.
exercises.prompt_en: Write the regular plural of kız.
hint_steps: Check whether the vowel is dotted or dotless.
Dotless ı is a back vowel.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Write kızlar; a dotless ı takes -lar.

exercises.instruction_en: Write the correct full plural form.
exercises.prompt_en: Write the regular plural of yol.
hint_steps: Find the only vowel in yol.
The vowel o is in the back group.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Write yollar, with -lar after o.

exercises.instruction_en: Write the correct full plural form.
exercises.prompt_en: Write the regular plural of üzüm.
hint_steps: Pay attention to the dots above the vowels.
The final vowel ü is front.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Write üzümler, not üzümlar.

exercises.instruction_en: Write the correct full plural form.
exercises.prompt_en: Write the regular plural of kalem.
hint_steps: Use the last vowel of kalem.
The vowel e selects -ler.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Write kalemler as one word, not kalemlar or kalem ler.

exercises.instruction_en: Write the correct full plural form.
exercises.prompt_en: Write the regular plural of çocuk.
hint_steps: Keep the singular noun unchanged.
The final vowel u requires -lar.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Write çocuklar; neither çocuğlar nor çocukler is right.

exercises.instruction_en: Choose the correct plural form.
exercises.prompt_en: A market label needs the plural of elma. Choose the correctly spelt label.

options.explanation_en: The final a is back, so use -lar.
-ler conflicts with the back vowel a.
No space before the plural ending.
Do not repeat -lar.

hint_steps: Identify the last vowel in elma.
The final a selects -lar.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: The correct market label is elmalar.

exercises.instruction_en: Choose the correct plural form.
exercises.prompt_en: Choose the correct plural label for biber.

options.explanation_en: Front vowel e requires -ler.
The final e is front, so use -ler.
The plural is written as one word.
Only one plural ending is needed.

hint_steps: Look for the last vowel in biber.
That vowel e is front.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Use biberler, not biberlar.

exercises.instruction_en: Transform the singular noun into its regular plural.
exercises.prompt_en: The singular market label is armut. Write its plural form.
hint_steps: Use the last vowel of armut.
The final vowel u is back.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: The correct plural label is armutlar.

exercises.instruction_en: Transform the singular noun into its regular plural.
exercises.prompt_en: The singular market label is domates. Write its plural form.
hint_steps: Look at the final vowel, not the first one.
The last vowel e is front.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Write domatesler, with -ler.

exercises.instruction_en: Correct the wrongly spelt plural noun.
exercises.prompt_en: A learner wrote köpeklar. Correct the complete plural word.
hint_steps: Find the final vowel in the noun köpek.
That vowel e is front.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Change -lar to -ler: köpekler.

exercises.instruction_en: Correct the wrongly spelt plural noun.
exercises.prompt_en: A learner wrote portakaller. Correct the complete plural word.
hint_steps: Find the last vowel of portakal.
It is a, a back vowel.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Replace -ler with -lar: portakallar.

exercises.instruction_en: Write the correct full plural form.
exercises.prompt_en: Without an example, write the regular plural of çiçek.
hint_steps: The last vowel decides the suffix.
The last vowel e is front.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: çiçek ends in a front vowel, so write çiçekler.

exercises.instruction_en: Transform the singular noun into its regular plural.
exercises.prompt_en: Without an example, change sokak into its regular plural.
hint_steps: Check the final vowel in sokak.
The final vowel is a, which selects -lar.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: The correct form is sokaklar, not sokakler.

exercises.instruction_en: Choose the correct plural form.
exercises.prompt_en: Which regular plural of pencere is correctly written?

options.explanation_en: The final e requires -ler.
A suffix does not stand alone.
The final e selects -ler.
A single plural suffix is enough.

hint_steps: Identify the final vowel of pencere.
Its final e is a front vowel.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: pencere becomes pencereler with -ler.

exercises.instruction_en: Write the correct full plural form.
exercises.prompt_en: Without an example, write the regular plural of kadın.
hint_steps: Look at the vowel nearest the end.
Dotless ı belongs to the back group.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: The correct form is kadınlar, with -lar.

exercises.instruction_en: Write from memory and check your work.
exercises.prompt_en: From memory, write the regular plurals of these four classroom words. Then check the spelling of each.
hint_steps: For each noun, find its final vowel.
Choose -lar for back vowels and -ler for front vowels.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Compare each word with the self-check criteria.
exercises.explanation_en: Reference answers: kitaplar, kalemler, okullar, kediler.

criteria_en: All four complete nouns are written as a single word.
No original noun stem is changed.

exercises.instruction_en: Write from memory and check your work.
exercises.prompt_en: Without looking at the table, write four regular plural labels for these foods. Compare each with the reference forms.
hint_steps: Decide which final vowels are front and which are back.
a and u take -lar; e takes -ler.
exercises.feedback_correct_en: Correct. The complete plural matches the last vowel and is written as one word.
exercises.feedback_wrong_en: Compare each word with the self-check criteria.
exercises.explanation_en: Reference answers: elmalar, armutlar, biberler, domatesler.

criteria_en: All four plural labels use the correct whole-word spelling.
The ending is attached without a space.

vocabulary_audit.note: All Turkish context and question content uses reviewed A1 dictionary headwords, approved names, or the regular -lar/-ler plural of an allowed noun. The plural suffixes are grammar, not vocabulary lemmas. Incorrect choices are explicit spelling errors based on permitted nouns.

level_audit.note: Only regular noun plurals are taught and scored. The next lesson covers nouns after cardinal numbers; this lesson does not teach that structure. Context lines use A1 inventory labels and brief greetings, without introducing later sentence patterns.

authoritative_sources_consulted.title: Yazım Kılavuzu – Sesler ve Ses Uyumları
authoritative_sources_consulted.verified_rule: Regular suffix vowel harmony matches -lar to back final vowels (a/ı/o/u) and -ler to front final vowels (e/i/ö/ü).

authoritative_sources_consulted.title: Türkçenin Yabancı Dil Olarak Öğretimi Programı (2. Baskı), p. 125
authoritative_sources_consulted.verified_rule: A1 curriculum explicitly includes the plural suffix -lar/-ler, with introductory nouns such as kalemler, kitaplar and defterler.
